$description: Design For Humans - Tier 3 Component Design Tokens (W3C DTCG Standard)

accordion.$description: Accordion molecule (details and summary) and accordion group tokens

compact-padding-block.$description: Summary and content padding in a compact accordion

hover-bg.$description: Summary tint on hover, as a plain button's

icon-size.$description: The plus/minus state icon; follows the summary text

group-gap.$description: Gap between accordions in a group

avatar.$description: Avatar atom and avatar group tokens

group-overlap.$description: Share of an avatar hidden by the next in a stacked group

group-ring-width.$description: Ring in the surface colour around stacked avatars

gap.$description: Space between a lockup's lines

badge.$description: Count or dot attached to a host element. Colour comes from the Tier 2 intent roles.

size.$description: Minimum block and inline size of a count badge

status.$description: State of a thing: text with an optional dot or icon. Colour comes from the Tier 2 intent roles.

min-size.$description: A status's minimum height: the small button's, so the two line up side by side. Plain, small and compact statuses take their content's height.

translucency.$description: How far the tint surface fades on the default (outline) prominence

list.$description: Bulleted and numbered lists outside prose, spaced like prose's bare lists.

indent.$description: Inline-start indent that holds the markers, as prose.indent

gap.$description: Space between items, half the prose block space. Compact sizing halves it

border-block-end-width.$description: Heavier lower edge that reads as a physical key

icon.$description: Inline SVG glyph sized in em, so it follows the text around it.

icon-box.$description: Fixed square frame around an icon, aligned with control sizes.

padding.$description: Padding between the banner edge and its icon, body and actions

body-padding.$description: Inline padding of the banner body; half of it on the block axis

gap.$description: Gap between icon, body and actions, and between lines of the body

translucency.$description: How much of the surface shows through a translucent banner

filter.$description: Backdrop filter of a translucent banner

banner-dock.$description: Placement container that pins a banner to the page edge

z-index.$description: Stacking layer of a sticky or fixed dock

padding-block.$description: Block padding around a floating dock banner

padding-inline.$description: Inline padding around a floating dock banner

batch-actions.$description: The bar shown while items are selected: a summary, actions and a way to clear the selection

docked-bg.$description: Surface of a docked or inline bar

filter.$description: Backdrop filter of the floating bar

gap.$description: Gap between the summary, actions and dismiss button

offset.$description: Distance of the floating bar from the bottom of the viewport

z-index.$description: Stacking layer of a floating or docked bar

color.$description: Tone: text and border at rest, fill on hover

padding-inline.$description: Horizontal inline padding for block link

padding-block.$description: Vertical block padding for block link

radius.$description: Border radius for block link container

transition.$description: Smooth transition duration for surface and color changes

breadcrumb.$description: The trail of ancestors of the current page

gap.$description: Space between an item and its separator

navigation-tree.$description: Nested links to the sections of a site or page. Its items are buttons.

gap.$description: Space between rows

color.$description: Text colour of an item that isn't current

rule-width.$description: Guide line beside a nested list (--ruled)

current-color.$description: Text colour of the current item

rail-width.$description: Minimum width of the current-location rail; the button's radius wins when it is larger

lockup-gap.$description: Gap between paired text inside a button lockup

button-group.$description: A set of related buttons laid out together

gap.$description: Gap between buttons

compact-gap.$description: Gap between buttons in a compact group

rule-width.$description: Rule between buttons in a ruled group

border-width.$description: Card edge; default, strong and subtle-less prominences

intent-ring-width.$description: Extra ring outside the border of a card with an intent, so the state shows at more than one pixel without moving the content

intent-shadow-transparency.$description: How far an intent card's shadow colour is mixed towards transparent (the .shadow-accent utility uses the same)

hover-shadow.$description: Shadow on hover for a linked card

padding.$description: Outer padding of the card parts

band-gap.$description: Gap between items in a band

chip.$description: Token representing a value: a selected option, an active filter, a category or tag.

min-size.$description: A chip's minimum height: the small button's, so the two line up side by side. Plain, small and compact chips take their content's height.

remove-target.$description: Minimum hit area of the remove button (WCAG 2.5.8)

width.$description: Inline size of a modal dialog; set --dialog-width on one dialog to change it

cushion.$description: Space kept between a centred dialog and the screen edge

max-height.$description: Tallest a centred dialog grows before its body scrolls

divider.$description: Divider rule tokens. Organisms place the divider; they don't restyle it.

strong-color.$description: --strong line colour, at least 3:1, for a rule that is the only boundary

empty-state.$description: Layout of the block shown where content would be: a search miss, a first use, a cleared queue

gap.$description: Space between the visual, the text and the actions

compact-gap.$description: Space between the parts in a compact region

content-max-width.$description: Measure of the title and description

subtle-padding.$description: Padding inside the dashed frame of --subtle

subtle-bg.$description: Tint inside the dashed frame of --subtle

gap.$description: Space between a field's label, hint, error and control

inline-gap.$description: Space between label and control in an inline field or an aligned form

label-width.$description: Label column width in an aligned form

gap.$description: Space between a fieldset's legend, hint and controls
Space between the box and its label text

compact-gap.$description: Space beside the box in a compact container

font-size.$description: Choice text, matching the text controls beside it

compact-font-size.$description: Choice text in a compact container, matching small text controls

compact-target.$description: Row height in a compact container (32px, as for small text controls)

gap.$description: Space between fields and fieldsets

actions-space.$description: Extra space above the form actions

lg-box-size.$description: Large checkbox and radio box size

sm-box-size.$description: Small box, only inside a label that is the target (a compact .choice)

compact-padding-block.$description: Block padding of a bar in a compact header

gap.$description: Space between the parts of a bar

max-width.$description: Width cap of a bar, so it lines up with .wrapper

shadow.$description: Shadow while a sticky header is stuck

z-index.$description: Stacking order of a sticky header

gap.$description: Gap between the parts of a bar

max-width.$description: Width cap of a bar's content, lined up with .wrapper

underline-color.$description: Underline at the full link colour, so it carries the link cue at the same contrast as the text (WCAG 1.4.1)

transition.$description: Transition duration for link color states

hover-underline-thickness.$description: Underline thickness on hover: the hover cue, with no second colour

pagination.$description: A button group of page links

gap.$description: Gap between page links

gap-color.$description: Colour of the gap marker for skipped pages

stepper.$description: The steps of one task: done, current and left

gap.$description: Space between an indicator and its text, and between steps

compact-indicator-size.$description: Indicator diameter in a compact stepper

indicator-bg.$description: Fill of an upcoming, current or invalid indicator

indicator-color.$description: Number and ring colour of an upcoming step

indicator-border-color.$description: Ring colour of an upcoming step

current-color.$description: Ring and number colour of the current step

complete-color.$description: Fill of a complete step, and the track after it

complete-on-color.$description: Check colour on a complete step

invalid-color.$description: Ring, icon and title colour of an invalid step

track-width.$description: Thickness of the line between steps

popover.$description: Popover layer tokens. The popover draws no surface: its card or menu does.

max-width.$description: Widest a popover grows before its content wraps; a product or container may raise it

offset.$description: Gap between the invoker and the popover

space.$description: Space between blocks in prose at fixed sizing. Compact sizing halves it

space-fluid.$description: Space between blocks in prose at fluid sizing

space-cq.$description: Space between blocks in prose at container-query sizing

indent.$description: Inline-start indent for lists, description details and blockquotes

hyphens.$description: Hyphenation for prose paragraphs and lists (none or auto)

code-block-bg.$description: Background of a code block (dark in both themes)

code-block-text.$description: Text colour of a code block

scroll-margin.$description: Space kept above an anchored element when it is scrolled to. A product with a sticky header adds the header height here

radius.$description: Corner radius for meter track and indicator

optimum-bg.$description: Fill color for optimum range in meter

suboptimum-bg.$description: Fill color for sub-optimum / warning range in meter

critical-bg.$description: Fill color for critical / danger range in meter

transition.$description: Transition speed for meter value changes

radius.$description: Corner radius for progress track and fill

track-bg.$description: Background track fill for progress bar

transition.$description: Transition speed for progress value changes
Transition speed for hover and active thumb states

picker-icon-size.$description: Chevron size, relative to the select text

background-color.$description: High-contrast accent surface for skip link banner

text.$description: Inverted foreground text color on accent surface

underline-color.$description: Underline stroke color on hover and active

font-size.$description: Typography font size for skip link

font-weight.$description: Typography font weight for skip link

min-size.$description: Minimum touch and click target size meeting WCAG 2.5.5 AAA

transition.$description: Smooth expansion transition duration when focused

floating-inset.$description: Distance of the floating skip link from the viewport corner

cell-sticky-bg.$description: Background color for sticky table cells

inner-border-color.$description: Border color for inner table dividers

inner-border-width.$description: Border width for inner table dividers

row-hover-bg.$description: Hover background color for table rows

row-stripe-bg.$description: Alternating background color for striped table rows

radius.$description: Outer corner radius for card/contained tables

inset.$description: Inline padding of the first and last cells. A flush card body sets it to the card padding; --plain sets it to 0

col-index-width.$description: Width of an index, counter or checkbox column

col-sm-width.$description: Small column width (times, durations, short states)

border-width.$description: Border width for switch control container

height.$description: Height of switch control matching target size

padding-inline.$description: Horizontal padding for switch segment options

font-size.$description: Font size for switch option labels

font-weight.$description: Font weight for active switch option labels

off-bg.$description: Background color for active Off segment

off-color.$description: Text color for active Off segment

on-bg.$description: Background color for active On segment

on-color.$description: Text color for active On segment

transition.$description: Transition speed for toggle state changes

tab.$description: Tab atom: one tab in a tab list

min-size.$description: Tab height and minimum width: the 48px target

padding-inline.$description: Inline padding of segmented and vertical tabs; horizontal underline tabs have none

inner-gap.$description: Gap between a tab's icon, label and badge

border-width.$description: Border width of outline segmented tabs

transition.$description: Duration of tab colour and fill changes

min-size.$description: Small tab height; the hit area stays at the target size

padding-inline.$description: Small segmented and vertical tab inline padding

tab-list.$description: Tab list molecule: owns the axes and the sliding selection indicator

gap.$description: Gap between underline tabs

tight-gap.$description: Gap in a tight tab list

rule-width.$description: Rule under (or beside) an underline tab list

rule-color.$description: Rule colour; decorative, the indicator carries the state

indicator-width.$description: Selection line width on underline tabs

indicator-color.$description: Selection line and segmented fill colour

content-padding-block.$description: Vertical padding of non-tab content in a list item

padding.$description: Padding inside a floating tab list

docked-offset.$description: Distance of a docked tab list from the viewport's bottom edge

tabbed-content.$description: Tabbed content organism: a tab list and its panels

gap.$description: Gap between the tab list and the panels

subtle-bg.$description: Fill of a subtle telemetry (--subtle), which has no border

gap.$description: Space between label and value

icon-gap.$description: Space between the icon and the label

lead-icon-size.$description: Icon size in the inline-start gutter (--icon-start)

lead-icon-gap.$description: Space between the gutter icon and the label and value

toast.$description: Toast notification stack and overlay tokens

shadow.$description: Floating elevation shadow for toast items

max-width.$description: Maximum inline size of a toast

gap.$description: Spacing between stacked toast items

offset.$description: Viewport edge offset distance for toast stack

transition.$description: Transition duration for toast entry and exit

tooltip.$description: Tooltip tokens: a short line of plain text on an inverted surface

font-weight.$description: Tooltip text weight; size and line height come from the small-text step

offset.$description: Gap between the invoker and the tooltip, room for the arrow

arrow-size.$description: Side of the square rotated to make the arrow

max-width.$description: Widest a tooltip grows before its text wraps

menu.$description: A list of actions, usually in a popover. Its items are buttons.

strong-shadow.$description: Raised shadow for a strong (floating) menu

padding.$description: Space between the frame and the items

rule-width.$description: Rule between items in a ruled menu

skeleton.$description: Loading placeholder shapes. The fill mixes the text colour so it shows the same on any surface.

shimmer.$description: Shimmer sweep: the page surface passing over the fill

radius-round.$description: Radius for avatar and badge shapes

duration.$description: One cycle of the shimmer or pulse

combobox.$description: Combobox molecule: the list and its options. The field's frame comes from the input tokens.

option-selected-color.$description: Selected options also show a check icon

gutter.$description: Inline space kept beside the content
